_comment: Recorded sounds Pacenote wants from Openverse (tools/audio/openverse_sounds.py --wishlist). Each pack lands in assets_src/audio/openverse/<pack>/ and is cooked by tools/audio/cook_sfx.py into assets/sounds/sfx/<pack>_<n>.ogg. 'use' says where the game plays it (docs/festival/AUDIO_PASS.md). Synthesised cues (skill ticks, UI clicks, pops) stay synthesised; these add the real-world layer.

packs.use: event finish: spectators cheer; louder on a win (RunCue finish)
event start line and race grid, before GO
Radar Post flash (RadarFlash), under the synthesised chime
Notes earned (MoneyEarned) and a purchase in the Dealership
Service Park menu bed and the service park in the world
farms and outskirts, now and then as you pass
traffic honks after a near miss or when blocked
stones hitting the underbody on loose gravel and washouts
car scraping a steel guard rail (roadside rails as walls)
